steps: Let L be the side of the cube and rho_w be the density of water (1 g/cm^3).
Case 1: Cube + 800g mass floats fully submerged: (M_cube + 800)g = rho_w * L^3 * g.
Case 2: Cube floats with 2cm above water: M_cube * g = rho_w * L^2 * (L - 2) * g.
Subtracting the two equations: 800 = rho_w * L^3 - rho_w * L^2 * (L - 2).
